binders: An arbitrary type Ω equipped with a measurable-space structure.
A measure μ on Ω equipped with the structure asserting that μ is a probability measure.
A real-valued function X : Ω → Real.
conclusions: In ENNReal, ∫_Ω |X(ω)|^p dμ(ω) = p ∫_{0}^{∞} μ({ω ∈ Ω | |X(ω)| > t}) t^(p-1) dt, where all terms are interpreted through ENNReal.ofReal as displayed in the target.
If either the extended p-th moment or the weighted tail integral is finite, then their ENNReal.toReal values are equal as real numbers.
mathematical_definitions: LocalDef001 μ X p := ∫⁻ ω with respect to μ, ENNReal.ofReal(|X(ω)|^p).
The weighted tail expression is ENNReal.ofReal(p) multiplied by the extended nonnegative Lebesgue integral over t∈(0,∞) of μ({ω | t<|X(ω)|}) · ENNReal.ofReal(t^(p-1)).
For an ENNReal quantity, being strictly below top means being finite.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every measurable real-valued random variable X on a probability space and every positive real p, the extended p-th absolute moment of X equals p times the integral over positive thresholds t of the tail probability that |X| exceeds t, weighted by t^(p-1). In addition, whenever at least one side is finite, converting the two extended values to ordinary real numbers gives the same equality.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The exponent is restricted to p>0.
The function X is required to be measurable, and μ is required to be a probability measure.
No integrability or finite-moment hypothesis is imposed for the main ENNReal equality; either side may equal infinity.
The second conclusion is conditional and imposes no requirement when both ENNReal expressions are infinite.

Because the first conclusion identifies the two ENNReal expressions, finiteness of either one entails finiteness of the other; the disjunctive finiteness premise is therefore symmetric but redundant between its two alternatives.
ENNReal.ofReal truncates negative inputs, but p is positive, |X|^p is nonnegative, and t is restricted to t>0, so this truncation does not alter the intended nonnegative factors.
ambiguities: There is no material ambiguity about LocalDef001 because its full definition is supplied.
The powers are Lean's Real.rpow rather than an unspecified integer or natural power.

The displayed tail event t<|X(ω)| is the strict event {|X|>t}; changing it to a non-strict event would be a different literal integrand, even though such variants may agree almost everywhere in related layer-cake formulas.
